name: Magna International Inc.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, accession 0001193125-26-128771), cover page: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Common Shares', trading symbol MGA, listed on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS; the financial statements are stated 'in millions, except number of common shares' and the same shares trade as MG on the TSX
ads_ratio.reason: Magna is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded MGA share is one common share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.

overrides_applied.source: Form 40-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, accession 0001193125-26-128771), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Equity: 'Stock-based compensation expense' $60M in FY2025 and $49M in FY2024; EDGAR companyfacts carries the identical series under us-gaap AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue ($45M FY2023 / $49M FY2024 / $60M FY2025, 40-F filings 2024-03-28, 2025-03-28, 2026-03-27) — a tag the engine does not map; its own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) carry no values for the gated years.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The filer's own reported stock-based compensation expense fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. $49M is the filed FY2024 figure, and FY2024 is the median year of the 3-yr normalized base, so the base is built from the exact filed figure; the error on the other years is at most $11M (~$0.04/share) and in the conservative direction for FY2025 (true $60M). SBC is ~0.1% of revenue — immaterial to the verdict either way.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, accession 0001193125-26-128771), cover page: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Common Shares', trading symbol MGA, listed on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS; the financial statements are stated 'in millions, except number of common shares' and the same shares trade as MG on the TSX) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 40-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, accession 0001193125-26-128771), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Equity: 'Stock-based compensation expense' $60M in FY2025 and $49M in FY2024; EDGAR companyfacts carries the identical series under us-gaap AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue ($45M FY2023 / $49M FY2024 / $60M FY2025, 40-F filings 2024-03-28, 2025-03-28, 2026-03-27) — a tag the engine does not map; its own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) carry no values for the gated years.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 7.92 vs 3-yr median 4.90 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (8.7%) vs bull-case tier C (13.9%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
